_comment: Pinned FFmpeg/ffprobe sidecar builds. The app NEVER uses system ffmpeg. fetch-sidecars (scripts/, added in the packaging step) downloads these exact files, verifies sha256 against the UNSIGNED source, then ad-hoc signs them for macOS. Bump ffmpeg_version + checksums together, in one commit.
